title: Microsoft Teams: shared display mode and BYOD peripheral detection in GCC High and DoD
summary: Hold: the briefing confuses default-on portal ingestion with client collection, which Microsoft documents as off by default in government clouds. Licensing statements also omit alternative entitlements and the billing-account restriction on free Single Space licences, and the low cost rating conflicts with the documented add-on licensing.

claims.claim: The low cost rating is consistent with the briefing's documented add-on licensing.
claims.quote:
cost: "low"
licensing: model: "add-on"
Low. The BYOD inventory needs at least one Teams Rooms Pro, Premium or Teams Shared Device licence in the tenant; per-room usage reports need a Teams Shared Space licence

Additional licensing may be needed for selected rooms; admin time is an indirect cost.' Low is reserved by the standard for indirect costs only.
